method: Computer Use opened seven disposable peer browser tabs from the packaged app, process state was sampled at the eight-tab peak, and Computer Use closed every disposable peer.
notes: The resident ordinary-browser guest count stayed at the documented limit of six even with eight browser metadata tabs.
Closing the seven disposable tabs returned the packaged app to one browser guest and the two-renderer app baseline.

Cleanup renderer RSS remained 44,240 KiB (20.5%) above the pre-peak sample. A single cycle cannot distinguish normal Chromium caching from a persistent leak, so this artifact does not claim a memory trend.
No blur, filter, or persistent will-change is applied to browser hosts, content planes, individual tabs, or webviews.
